Cybersecurity Specialist

GRC · Privacy compliance · Cloud security · End-user support
  • Drive COPPA and FERPA compliance for a K-12 platform and build out the wider security program, starting from a NIST CSF gap assessment. Translate regulatory changes into policy, consent workflows, and tracked remediation.
